Dockerfile [ADAPTED_SOURCE_ONLY]: Adapt inert publisher packaging to the 10.5 multi-stage image. Bind packaged bytes to the clean reconciled source commit, include selected Codex and Workboard runtime plugins, and retain production ineligibility until separate image/native proof.
